title: Golden-output test harness for typed SDK responses and streaming retry semantics
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a reproducible 'golden output' test harness for the Python SDK that exercises typed response models (pydantic + dataclasses), streaming chunk reassembly, and retry/idempotency behaviors. The harness should produce deterministic fixtures that CI can validate across platforms and Python versions, provide a pytest plugin for test ergonomics, and include example end-to-end tests that simulate transient network errors, backpressure, and resumed streams with checkpoints. This will help prevent regressions in structured output parsing, streaming hydration, and retry policies when changing SDK parsing logic or runtime semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic golden fixtures produced for a representative set of API calls (chat, streaming generation, embeddings) using both pydantic and dataclass schemas
Pytest plugin (tests/conftest.py + plugin entry) that can generate/update golden files with --update-goldens flag and seed control
Streaming tests that validate chunk-order reassembly, partial-object merging, and checkpoint resume semantics under simulated transient errors
Retry semantics verified: idempotent replays, duplicate-chunk deduping, and client-visible error windows asserted
CI job (ci/goldens) fails on divergence and uploads diffs to the PR with links to failing examples
Docs and example app added: tests/examples/streaming_demo.py and a short README explaining how to write golden tests for new schema changes

decision_log: Use JSONL with a single header object for golden files instead of binary blobs to make diffs actionable in PRs
Support both pydantic and dataclass based fixtures; tests will import both constructors and run parity assertions
Seed-driven deterministic simulation of model outputs is preferred over snapshotting raw model responses to enable parametric test coverage
Golden files will be versioned with schema_version and stored under tests/goldens/<schema_version>/ to allow safe evolution and migration tooling
implementation_notes: Implementation split into three tasks: (1) deterministic fixture generator (utils/goldens.py) with RNG seeding, newline normalization, and environment headers; (2) pytest plugin providing fixtures: golden_fixture, replay_stream(simulated_events), update_goldens flag; (3) end-to-end example tests and CI integration. Important patterns: freeze dataclasses for equality checks, use soft-validators for fields that can drift (timestamps, ids), and provide a migration script tests/tools/migrate_goldens.py to bump schema_version when contract changes are intentional.
